title: KJ-360 家用空气净化器产品规格书

headings.text: KJ-360 家用空气净化器产品规格书

key_sentences: KJ-360是一款面向20至45平方米居室的家用空气净化器。
本机采用三层复合滤网，可同时去除颗粒物、甲醛和异味。
整机噪声在睡眠模式下不高于28分贝，适合卧室和儿童房使用。
开箱后请对照下表核对随机附件。
自购买之日起，整机享受一年免费保修，电机享受三年免费保修。
滤网属于耗材，不在保修范围之内。
保修期内因人为损坏或擅自拆机造成的故障，不享受免费维修服务。
如需维修，请拨打客服电话或通过官方网站提交服务申请。

list_items.text: １．三档风速与睡眠模式自动切换：
①睡眠模式下指示灯自动熄灭；
②风速根据空气质量传感器读数自动调整。
２．滤网寿命提醒，剩余寿命低于10%时指示灯变为红色。
３．童锁功能，长按锁定键3秒即可启用或解除。
请勿在浴室等潮湿场所使用本机。
清洁或更换滤网前务必拔下电源插头。
请勿遮挡进风口和出风口。
儿童须在成人监护下使用。
电源线破损时，须由专业维修人员更换。

notes: Simplified Chinese product specification, two pages. Chinese sentences are written without spaces: a line wrapped inside a sentence joins with NO space, and consecutive sentences join with no space. Running header: left block (company) and right block (document reference) are separate entries, listed once; centred page-number line per page ("第 1 页 共 2 页", "第 2 页 共 2 页"). Section headings carry TYPED Chinese ordinal markers ("一、" ... "六、"). The function list in section 三 has TYPED full-width markers "１．" "２．" "３．" at level 0 and circled "①" "②" at level 1, joined to the text with NO space, hanging indent. The precautions list in section 五 is DRAWN BY CSS (list-style cjk-ideographic, rendered 一、二、...), so its items carry no marker. Parameters table: zebra bands, section rows "（一）净化性能" etc. span three columns (repeated). The document-data panel is a 4-column key/value grid with no header row. Section 四 (packing list, borderless table) and the boxed section 五 stand SIDE BY SIDE and read box by box, left first. Warranty table: rules above and below the header and between rows. The closing company name and date (right-aligned) are body text, not recorded.
